authority: Static organizational policy for persistent formations and autonomous combined-arms operations. Exact manpower, formations, commanders, casualties, operations, ownership and appointments remain in their native campaign owners.

formation_command_structure.rule: Internal command billets are functions within the formation's already-conserved personnel unless separately represented by an attached formation or exact person. The organization record never creates extra bodies. A player-facing independent formation still requires lawful command authority; autonomous state formations may use aggregate staffed command when no named commander is individually relevant.

operation_depth.rule: Major state operations should draw several complementary persistent formations when exact available formations and authority permit. The operation layer coordinates them but does not merge their manpower, casualties or ownership.

great_bow_guard.rule: The 3,000-fighter Great Bow Guard preserves the campaign's 15 conserved recruitment cohorts and normalizes each to 200 fighters. Each cohort exposes one aggregate internal command candidate for later exact materialization or appointment; this does not create a sixteenth cohort or any extra fighter. A separate Sword Manor officer cadre may provide deputies, staff, signals, logistics and replacement command when exact House authority and conserved manpower permit.
